requiredInvariants: Every source matrix row has exactly one deterministic adapter row.
Every registered module receives exactly fifty shared source cases.
Every module case expands to Basic, Pro and Advanced in PL, EN and DE.
Every packet projects to API, UI, preview, PDF, Brain and Angel.
Every projection preserves packet ID, packet hash, facts hash and the exact claim set.
No channel may add, remove or silently rewrite a canonical claim.
Root case identity and root facts remain identical across derived modules.
Canonical claim IDs and facts remain semantically identical across locales.
Basic claims are a subset of Pro claims and Pro claims are a subset of Advanced claims.
Each tier upgrade adds at least eight material claims, two evidence families and one scenario.
Blocked source adapter states remain abstained and cannot be promoted by another channel.
No synthetic packet or projection may enable charge, LIVE, customer purchase-worthiness or release promotion.
truthBoundary: A81 orchestrates existing frozen synthetic corpus and adapter evidence into one source-bound cross-module and cross-channel matrix. It proves deterministic identity, tier monotonicity, projection parity and fail-closed promotion behavior only. It does not execute real providers, exact A80, a browser, physical customer PDFs, a model, customer outcomes, staging, LIVE or sale.

closedByA81.title: Separate adapter families had no single exact 2700-row completeness proof
closedByA81.closure: A81 requires one unique deterministic adapter row for every frozen source matrix row.

closedByA81.title: No shared root-case identity across Shield-derived and Lens-derived modules
closedByA81.closure: A81 binds derived modules to one root case hash and root facts hash.

closedByA81.title: Channel parity did not require an exact canonical claim set
closedByA81.closure: All six projections must preserve packet ID, packet hash, facts hash and exact claim IDs.

closedByA81.title: No explicit cross-locale semantic fact parity
closedByA81.closure: PL, EN and DE packets must retain the same canonical facts hash for each module/case/tier.

closedByA81.title: No unified tier monotonicity proof across all modules
closedByA81.closure: Basic claim sets must be subsets of Pro and Pro subsets of Advanced with fixed incremental floors.

closedByA81.title: A blocked source adapter state could be presented differently by another channel
closedByA81.closure: One analysis decision is bound into every API/UI/preview/PDF/Brain/Angel projection.

closedByA81.title: No unified mutation campaign against cross-channel promotion and claim drift
closedByA81.closure: A81 executes 36000 re-sealed deterministic projection mutations and requires 100 percent semantic kill rate.

closedByA81.title: Synthetic adapter orchestration could be confused with real provider, browser, PDF or model execution
closedByA81.closure: Every row and receipt records zero real executions and forbids LIVE, sale and purchase-worthiness credit.

closedByA81.title: No frozen A80 candidate digest exists for product execution binding
closedByA81.closure: A81 remains explicitly unbound and cannot grant product execution credit until a verified A80 candidate exists.

closedByA81.title: Brain and Angel lacked direct product-contract surfaces in the tier catalog
closedByA81.closure: A81 uses explicit source-surface modules without inventing paid product-cell readiness.

closedByA81.title: Current package metadata pointed to a stale A79 completion-program path and patch marker
closedByA81.closure: A81 binds velmerePass, patch, authority and completion-program metadata to the same current revision and path.

closedByA81.title: A80 release-candidate admission was hardcoded to the A80 source revision and could not safely evaluate a legal later descendant
closedByA81.closure: A81 generalizes the retained A80 admission boundary to require one consistent active/current/authority/descendant revision while preserving A80 as the admission-policy revision.

closedByA81.title: A80 blocked admission crashed when the external exact A60 receipt was absent from SOURCE_ONLY
closedByA81.closure: A81 treats a missing external A60 receipt as an explicit fail-closed blocker instead of an unhandled filesystem exception.

closedByA81.title: Canonical current-status verifier was hardcoded to A80 roadmap precedence
closedByA81.closure: A81 requires A81 at the roadmap head, retains A80 as explicit history and preserves the full canonical A32 section and 43 workstream rows.

closedByA81.title: Projection mutations retained the original digest and could be killed by stale-integrity detection instead of semantic validation
closedByA81.closure: A81 reseals every adversarial projection after mutation so all 36000 kills require the exact semantic verifier rather than a stale digest mismatch.

closedByA81.title: Projection verification did not bind adapter status and analysis decision to the expected source state
closedByA81.closure: A81 binds adapterStatus and analysisDecision for every projection and mutation-tests blocked/passed plus abstain/ready substitutions.

closedByA81.title: A fully resealed alternate runtime was not explicitly rejected against a fresh source-replay digest anchor
closedByA81.closure: A81 supports an expected runtime-integrity anchor, reruns the matrix from source-bound inputs and rejects a coherently resealed alternate runtime whose digest differs from the fresh replay.

closedByA81.title: Historical A58 release-integrity checks were hardcoded to specific descendant revisions
closedByA81.closure: A81 binds A58 current-source checks to the single current-release authority, current revision and active pass instead of A75 or A81 literals.

closedByA81.title: Clean-unpack verification order was not encoded and receipt-generating tests could pollute the A58 exact path-set
closedByA81.closure: A81 adds a one-shot clean-unpack sequence that always runs A58 archive/path integrity before any test allowed to create deterministic receipts.
